collectionMethod: Manual capture around 10:36 Beijing time / 02:36Z on 2026-11-23 of the official OpenCode Go documentation page (https://opencode.ai/docs/go/, which 301-redirects to /docs/console/go/), the Go landing page (https://opencode.ai/go, 302-redirects to /console/go), the documentation markdown export (https://opencode.ai/docs/console/go.md), the prerendered documentation HTML (https://opencode.ai/v2/docs/console/go), the OpenCode console changelog RSS feed (https://opencode.ai/console/changelog/rss.xml) and the full model catalog endpoint referenced by the documentation (https://opencode.ai/inference/go/v1/models). All surfaces were compared against the 2026-11-21 captures of the same URLs; the 2026-11-22 routine scan was not completed, so the 2026-11-21 captures are the baseline. Every price, limit, estimate and sentence below is transcribed as published. Research-only — no adopted row generated, no adopted value changed, no script changed, no chart or site change.
scope: OpenCode Go official catalog only. The change on 2026-11-23 is that the published monthly limit for GLM-5.3 moved back down from the temporary promotional tier (Go $500 / Go Plus $1000 / Go Teams $505, recorded in opencode-go-glm53-limit-round2-2026-11-19.json) to the standing tier Go $200 / Go Plus $400 / Go Teams $205 — the same values recorded in opencode-go-glm53-limit-round1-2026-11-18.json before the promotion started. The official documentation deleted the sentence 'GLM-5.3: Higher usage limits apply through November 22, 2026.', matching the published end date of the promotion. The three-part token price is unchanged. GLM-5.3-Flash and every other paid model's monthly_usage in the models API are unchanged. Research-only — not adopted; no computed allowance, no script change, no leaderboard/score data. LongCat catalog changes are handled in a separate PR and are not a topic of this file.
adoptionStatus: research-only; not adopted; the opencode_go × glm-5.3 adopted row was already merged on 2026-11-21 (#250, 087b092) at the standing $200 Go monthly limit (adopted value 6.468 亿/月), with the 4-day $500 temporary activity through 2026-11-22 left as a research / decision note and not entering the standing main value. This file records the official confirmation that the promotion has ended and the catalog has reverted to the standing tier; it does not change data/adopted.csv, does not change scripts/build_adopted.py, and changes no derived output.
